about_the_game:
Explore a strange house in the Venezuelan mountains, where every room echoes decades of tragedy. You arrive seeking the truth behind the Blanco family’s dark history... but the house has other plans. Here, past and present collide, exposing sectarian rituals and choices that doomed generations.

Unravel the Past

  • Echoes of Time: Explore a house fractured by time, where contrasting eras collide. From a seemingly idyllic 1970s to a decadent present, each step unveils terrifying details of the past.

  • Unique Horror, Local Soul: "Animas" weaves psychological terror with the soul of Venezuelan folklore. From ancient beliefs to modern urban legends, experience a face of horror rarely seen in video games.

  • An Oppressive Atmosphere: Experience terror firsthand. With an unsettling atmosphere and immersive 3D audio design, the line between reality and nightmare dissolves. Is it your mind whispering... or the house?

Authentic Voices, Global Reach

Experience terror with the authenticity of professional voice acting in Latin American Spanish, immersing yourself further in the unique cultural context of "Animas". And to ensure no one misses a single detail of this nightmare, all in-game dialogues and texts are subtitled in English, as well as Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian.

In this house, time does not heal wounds. It reopens them... again and again.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes and intense content, including symbolic violence, religious rituals inspired by real-world traditions (featuring non-explicit human sacrifice and self-mutilation), gore elements (blood, mutilated bodies), and sensitive narratives such as domestic abuse, familial trauma, and suicide. Discretion is advised for players sensitive to these topics.

name: Animas

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB) or RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Animas is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into the dark secrets of the Blanco family. Explore a cursed house in the Venezuelan mountains, where time unravels to reveal decades of sectarian rituals and familial tragedies.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish - Latin America*, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
